title: PatchProposal
description: The only structured output the kernel accepts from a provider turn. Full-file contents per changed path so application is deterministic and order-independent.

intent_summary.description: One-paragraph summary of what this proposal intends.

changes.description: Whole-file changes. contents is the complete new file body, or null for delete.

path.description: Repository-relative path. No leading slash, no '..' segments.

contents.description: Full new file contents; null if and only if op is delete.

tests_to_run.description: Deterministic commands the kernel should run as the gate.

claims.description: What the provider asserts is true after the change. Claims are never evidence.

uncertainties.description: What the provider is unsure about.

done.description: Provider's completion claim. Not authoritative; the gate decides.
